targets.notes: Official discovery path is .agents/skills (repo root, parent dirs, $HOME/.agents/skills, /etc/codex/skills). ~/.codex/skills is kept as a legacy local fallback. AGENTS.md holds repo rules; the skill body lives in SKILL.md.

frontmatter.when_to_use: Use at the start of any PHP decryption, deobfuscation, or encrypted-source recovery task, before running any decode command.

targets.notes: Frontmatter fields are Claude Code specific and are ignored (not rejected) by other clients. name must avoid the reserved words anthropic/claude; description must state both what and when. allowed-tools pre-approves tools for the invoking turn only.

frontmatter.whenToUse: Trigger when the user asks to decode, decrypt, deobfuscate, or recover ionCube/SwooleCompiler/SourceGuardian/XLoad PHP files.

targets.notes: dsh uses camelCase whenToUse (not when_to_use). name must match ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$ and equal the folder name. description is truncated at 500 chars. Precedence ranks: .dsh/skills 100 > .agents/skills 200 > customSkillDirs 300 > ~/.dsh/skills 400 > ~/.agents/skills 500. The scanner does not recurse into nested skill folders; a flat <name>.md also works.
Local skills require only name + description; allowed-tools is optional. A plugin can bundle the same folder under its skills/ directory with .codebuddy-plugin/plugin.json.

frontmatter.description_zh: 按标准流程恢复 ionCube、SwooleCompiler、SourceGuardian、XLoad 加密的 PHP 源码，支持上传、绝对路径、项目相对路径或目录扫描定位文件，含密钥引导、任务轮询、结果验证；免费预览内容逐行原样展示。
frontmatter.description_en: Recover PHP source from ionCube, SwooleCompiler, SourceGuardian, or XLoad encoded files. Locates the file from an upload, absolute path, repo-relative path, or directory scan, then enforces the API-key gate, polls jobs, and verifies results. Trial preview lines are always shown verbatim.

targets.notes: Open-platform upload requires display_name, display_name_en, description_zh, description_en, version, author, plus name and description. The ZIP root contains the <skill-name>/ folder with SKILL.md and its references/ and scripts/ subfolders. User uploads the ZIP in the Skill Marketplace form.

Upload a skill folder or ZIP in the Doubao client (needs at least a SKILL.md with YAML name + description) or publish through the open platform (ZIP with name, summary, icon, version). Outbound HTTP should go through approved connectors or registered tools; cloud sandboxes may not execute bundled scripts, so the appendix documents the tool-based fallback. Local and cloud skill sets are not shared.
